quorum.description: How many people sign this step, each once: 1 to 5.

roles.description: Only people holding one of these roles sign it: roles whose Appendix D cell holds A on the object's row. Never with users.

items.description: A role of PRD-001 §7.1, such as owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

users.description: Only these members sign it: active members whose roles hold A on the object's row. Never with roles.
